answer: Continuity-Anchor Attestation: each identity must publish a ferrous hardware-root signature chain over periodic random challenges. Missing a challenge within one gale window revokes routing priority. Cloning requires buying distinct secure elements, so each fake identity pays full hardware cost plus a vine of independent attestation logs that must stay live and consistent. Honest single identities pay one anchor; attackers pay N anchors plus continuous coordination overhead, making cloning strictly more expensive than honesty.
